title: Ergo Boss multi-tilter chair
body_html:
One chair, fitted three ways — because a 5'2" admin and a 6'4" director shouldn't have to sit in the same seat.

The Ergo Boss Multi-Tilter is Global's build-to-fit task chair, offered in three seat and back sizes so you can match the chair to the person while keeping one consistent look across the office. Every adjustment is independent — Soft Descent™ pneumatic seat height, seat depth, separate seat and back angles, tilt tension and lock, plus lumbar pressure and depth — and height/width-adjustable arms with articulating caps finish the fit. Built in Canada and backed by Global's Limited Lifetime Warranty.

Key features

  • Three seat and back sizes (Medium, High, and Executive High back)
  • Soft Descent™ pneumatic seat-height adjustment
  • Independent seat and back angle adjustment, with infinitely adjustable seat angle
  • Seat depth adjustment
  • Waterfall seat edge to promote circulation
  • Tilt lock and tilt-tension adjustment
  • Lumbar pressure and lumbar depth adjustment
  • Height- and width-adjustable arms with articulating arm caps
  • Bonded leather (black) or Fusion Fabric upholstery; choice of seat and back textiles
  • Hard-floor casters; 24-hour / multi-shift models available

Who it's for

Offices that want one task-chair platform sized to fit every body — administrative pools, private offices, and shared workstations — where a uniform look matters but a one-size seat doesn't work.

Brant Business Interiors carries the Ergo Boss Multi-Tilter and delivers across Ontario, with installation and a 7-day on-site demo available. Call 1-800-835-9565 to choose your back size, textile, and OECM pricing.
